text: In 1979, a small crew drives to a lonely farm in rural Texas to shoot a pornographic film in the guesthouse of an elderly couple, Howard and Pearl. Pearl fixes on the aspiring star Maxine, who looks like [Pearl in her youth|wants|cheating death and age], and secretly watches the filming with longing. After dark, [rebuffed by the young director|trigger|being spurned or shamed], she turns deadly, and [the crew are picked off|who_suffers|people at work] around the barn and [the alligator's lake|images|water and drowning].
